summary.intent: Use the GSD manager workflow to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) identified in a UAT audit (PR #484) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: All three phases were discussed and CONTEXT.md files committed; Phase 42 was fully planned (8 plans), executed across 3 waves with worktree isolation, code-reviewed, verified, and marked complete. Phases 43 and 44 planning was queued but the transcript ends before their execution.

repo: The `POST /ipfs/unpin` endpoint had no ownership check — it passed whatever CID arrived straight to Kubo `pin/rm` with only JwtAuthGuard; any JWT holder (open signup via Web3Auth) could destroy another user's content.

Kubo v0.40 runs with the `server` profile (not fully private): swarm port 4001 is publicly exposed, DHT provider records are broadcast for every pinned CID, making CIDs discoverable via crawlers regardless of content encryption.
Writable-share saves drop `prunedCids` without calling unpin — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists today.
BYO-IPFS unpin was broken bidirectionally: advisory rows were never inserted on BYO pin, and the unpin path never called `provider.unpin`.
The upload-compensation path in `ipfs.controller.ts:122` fires a global `pin/rm` that could hit CIDs shared via content-address dedup with other users.
GSD auto-manages per-phase `feat/` branches; main is never touched during planning/execution.
IPNS records are published to the public IPFS network (TEE republishing + recovery tool), making IPNS names resolvable by any external observer.
The `.planning/` directory and GSD-controlled markdown/JS files had no prettier or lint ignore rules — root cause of prettier mangling planning docs.
gsd commit helper (`query commit`) returns `"committed": false` as a false negative — always verify with `git log` rather than blind-retrying.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global `pin/rm` without ownership check, reaching CIDs shared via content-address dedup across users.
Kubo v0.40 uses `server` profile with swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (tcp+udp); `server` profile only disables local-network discovery, full public DHT participation continues.

Added `guardedUnpin`: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete + refcount in one transaction → if last reference insert pending_unpins outbox → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempts emit audit metric and return silent 2XX.
BullMQ WorkerHost with `drainPendingUnpins` (calls provider, not raw Kubo; error-isolates per row; publishes gauge) and `runDriftReport` (NDJSON parse, read-only, zero `.delete(` in drift path).
Added `quotaStore.fetchQuota()` reconcile call after `removeUsage()` via TDD (42-02); quota was previously only decremented locally.
New standalone quota-repair script; only runs for non-BYO users; uses dry-run guard; pure predicate logic extracted to backfill-helpers.ts for unit testability.
New Grafana alert in `CipherBox Security` rule group on `rate(cipherbox_unpin_cross_user_attempts_total[5m]) > 0`, using placeholder-UID convention.
Creates `pending_unpins` table with `id` (uuid PK), `cid` (varchar 255 unique), `created_at` (timestamp) — intentionally no `user_id` column.

workflow: pnpm/jest filter gotcha: `pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X` BREAKS because pnpm inserts `--` before the jest args, causing jest to treat `--testPathPattern` as a positional regex. Correct form: `pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.
worktree.cleanup-wave must run from repo root, not from within an agent worktree — the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd; running from a worktree produces false `base_mismatch` errors.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on rerun and abort the whole run. Write a reduced manifest containing only remaining entries for retry.
Worktrees accumulate `node_modules` and `.husky/_` as untracked dirs that block merges — rm them explicitly before running cleanup-wave.
1Password SSH signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git Bash calls; agent errors are transient and require user to restart 1Password app (never use `--no-gpg-sign` as workaround).

openapi.json can get formatting-only drift from `nest build` side effects in the main worktree — `git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json` before merging executor worktrees to avoid spurious conflicts.
42-05 merge produced MERGE_HEAD with no conflicts (all auto-resolved) but commit step failed silently — `git commit --no-edit` concludes it; then manually `git worktree remove` + `git branch -D`.
Prettier table rendering can mangle regex pipes in markdown tables (e.g., `\|` in test commands) — verify planning doc content after prettier runs, or add explicit escaping.

The gsd plan-checker's decision-coverage gate requires a literal `D-NN:` citation in `must_haves` — a mechanical grep, not semantic analysis; missing citations fail the gate even with complete coverage.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures occurred multiple times requiring user to restart the 1Password app; no workaround exists short of disabling signing which is not allowed.
gsd commit helper returning `"committed": false` as a false negative caused repeated unnecessary retries and confusion about whether commits landed.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent and aborts on first blocked entry — required writing reduced manifests for each retry, adding manual bookkeeping overhead.
Planner agent hit a socket error mid-session after writing plans 01-03, requiring a filesystem fallback and continuation planner spawn for plans 04-08.
worktree cleanup failed when run from wrong cwd (inside a worktree) producing misleading `base_mismatch` errors — root cause was undocumented cwd sensitivity.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD with all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step silently failing — required manual diagnosis and `git commit --no-edit` to conclude.
openapi.json formatting drift from a `nest build` side effect in the main tree caused a spurious conflict during the 42-05 merge.
User accidentally typed 'touring wyatt web bossy' twice as input, interrupting active tool calls and requiring explicit 'please continue' to resume.
Session hit context window limit mid-code-review causing a full context summary + resume cycle.
Prettier had no ignore rules for `.planning/` and GSD-controlled files, causing it to mangle planning doc content (broke a regex in a test command table).
open_items: Phases 43 (FUSE write durability) and 44 (IPNS conflict handling) still need planning and execution — they were discussed and CONTEXT.md files committed but not yet planned/executed.
SECURITY.md is missing for Phase 42 — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` needs to be run to close the security enforcement gate.
BYO provider.unpin client wiring deferred: server side now handles 'not pinned' gracefully but the BYO client never calls provider.unpin on delete.
Writable-share prunedCids leak: `shared-write.ts:450` drops prunedCids without unpinning — deferred from Phase 42 scope.
Pending-uploads UI deferred: user noted the full pending-uploads UI should be tracked as a future improvement (from Phase 43 discussion).
Rust FUSE merge parity deferred from Phase 44 scope — IPNS conflict handling Rust parity not included in this milestone.
Traceability warning surfaced during `query phase.complete 42` was noted but not resolved in transcript.
Drift report is detect-only (read-only, no auto-GC) — pre-existing historical orphan pins from before quota tracking are known to exist but not cleaned up.
